Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Counter affidavit filed today by learned AGA is taken on record.

2. Heard Sri Mahesh Chandra Tiwari, learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri Ratan Singh,
learned AGA for the State.
3.

This writ petitions have been filed for quashing the impugned First Information Report dated 15.04.2023 in Case Crime No. 188 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506, 377, 376 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Etamaddaula, District Agra.

4. Learned A.G.A. for the State-respondents submitted that the charge-sheet no. 287 of 2023 has been against filed against petitioner no. 1 and 4 on 03.06.2023 whereas other co-accused persons were exonerated and, as such, the cause for filing present writ petitions no more survives.
5. In view of above, the writ petition is dismissed as having become infructuous.
